'''Cybot Galactica''' ('''CG''') was one of the two largest [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing companies in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the other being [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].

==History==
Cybot Galactica dominated the market in nonmilitary droids, especially [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]]. The company was headquartered on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It excelled in marketing and design, but was also known to have expensive products. However, the wide-ranging service and support Cybot Galactica made up for this. Almost all major and minor [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] worlds had at least one Cybot sales and service center. Because of how common their products and service centers were, mechanics had a comparatively easy time repairing and modifying Cybot droids. Like other droid manufacturers, Cybot Galactica utilized the expansive production facilities on [[Telti/Legends|Telti]], as well as those on the planet [[Affa/Legends|Affa]] for their protocol division.<ref name="Scavenger's Guide to Droids">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

Cybot Galactica was a major force in galactic history and a powerful influence in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the Corporate Sector. The corporation was known for a wide range of droid models ranging from simple labor droids to advanced security models. They also produced computer equipment and electronics.

[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was built by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] out of parts from scrapped Cybot Galactica droids in one of [[Watto/Legends|Watto's]] junk piles.<ref name="TtM">{{Tales|6|Thank the Maker}}</ref> A similar protocol droid, [[C-3PX]], was modified by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] to serve as an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]].<ref name="EI TFoDM">''[[Episode I Adventures 3: The Fury of Darth Maul]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Cybot Galactica collaborated with [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] to make the [[All-Terrain Exploration Droid]].<ref name="EotEEtU">''[[Enter the Unknown]]''</ref>
